ai_summary: KOKUYO CAMLIN LIMITED has received a regulatory notice from the Registrar of Companies (ROC) requesting clarifications and historical records concerning an employee fraud and discrepancies between book and physical inventory quantities from 2024. While the company states there is no immediate material impact, this inquiry into past fraud and significant inventory issues is a material red flag, suggesting potential weaknesses in internal controls and carrying risks of future financial or reputational consequences.
